rows: Stop. Which technique? Say the name and then show me.
Brawling? Fine. Who is getting hit first, and why?
Slow? That is not an answer. What is the pace?
The people are waiting. You are wasting their time. Say something real.
I want the top billing and I am not waiting for it. Why not me?
Look at the stance, go on. Ready. Watch me move.
Technique? Which one? Name one, right now, or stop talking about it.
Strikes. Which ones? When? Be specific.
A risk. Fine. What does it cost you if it fails?
A stall, really? In front of a crowd? Really?
The people want a real contest. Why are you still standing there?
Among the best? Says who? What is the reason? Name it.
Proud of your {strength}? Why? Give me one example. Why? Give me one example.
I have clocked your {strength}. Now tell me the bit you are hiding.
You are composed, so why not answer? Well done? Show me more. Now tell me why you did.
Noted. That is one answer. Give me the next one.
I could tell you what I think. I want you to tell me why you said it first.
One fall, and then what? Clear rules. What happens if you break them?
On the mat, I ask a question every time you move. Answer each one.
Grounded or standing, the question stays the same. Why are you here?
Stay where you are. Tell me your next move, now.
That answer, meh. Why that one, though?
Still nothing. Why? I asked a yes or no question. Answer it, now.
Understood. Now explain why it matters to you.
I will fight this match until the bell, and I want a reason from you before it starts.
My approach is straightforward. Give me the reason and I give you the match.
Whatever happens, you will know exactly why I did it.
We are not done. I have a question still open.
I have one more question, and you will answer it when the bell goes.
Why did I say that? Good question. I haven't got one example that proves it. I withdraw it.
Ask me for specifics and I should have them ready. I don't. That accusation goes.
Right. You've answered the question. Don't bring that claim back without evidence.
That's clearer. Now the question is what you can do in the ring.
